dict.string: The Trycorder viewer shows the camera and takes pictures of your away mission.
The Trycorder listens to voice commands, shows the audio waveform and streams push-to-talk audio.
The Trycorder recognizes commands such as "computer phaser".
The temperature sensor page shows the barometric pressure.
The orientation sensor shows where you are on this planet.
The galleries show the pictures and videos taken by the Trycorder.
The Trycorder saves the pictures and videos it takes.
The crew module reads and evaluates your crew (contacts).
The Trycorder talks to other Trycorders on the local network.
